s: December 1, 2017 - A number of key lessons were provided by Black Wednesday. The government had, at various times, tried to cut borrowing, restrict different measures of the money supply, shadowed the mark and joined the ERM in the hope of securing low and stable inflation. Now it decided to target low and stable inflation directly through an inflation target. The monetary framework that exists today had its genesis on 16 September 1992. Politicians of both parties also realised that ceding control over interest rates and the exchange rate was a risky business.
